text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for this bountiful wind. I will
savor it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... I didn't realize there was an
Arrow-Wing
in the area...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Survival of the fittest is a law of nature. I
can only
accept the consequences of my
inattention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her sandwich having been swiped by a
black kite,
Yamanin Zephyr is left to go
without any lunch.
